name: Macquarie Education Costs Scholarship
summary: Yearly payment for full-time Macquarie undergraduates receiving Youth Allowance or another means-tested payment.
key: $6,000 per year, for up to 4 years.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder
Receiving Youth Allowance or another means-tested Commonwealth payment
how: Apply via the UAC Equity Scholarship Application Portal
catches: The page still shows 2024 round dates; check UAC for the current round

source.label: Macquarie University: Macquarie Education Costs Scholarship

evidence.quote: Applicants need to be in receipt of Youth Allowance or any other means tested Commonwealth support payment
